1-expert: Maria: 24 years in accounts payable. Her reasons live only in her head. She retires soon.
2-screen: She shares her screen and works. At a pause, GroundZero asks why and keeps her exact words.
3-paper: Physical steps leave no screen trace, so it listens. Any action counts, barista to data center engineer.
4-map: After a debrief and teach-back comes a Work Map: steps, decisions, her reasons, and guardrails.
5-teach: Then a coach: A R for paper, a voice tutor on screen, quoting Maria before a wrong save.
6-agent: Work Maps join the Human Skills Marketplace, so agents load the same guardrails. Capture, map, teach.
